thread:
nina: Heads-up: a triage run pulled ~8 hours of gateway logs this morning. We need to hard-limit export windows and tighten KMS unwrap policy.
omar: Oof. Which path? stream vs snapshot?
nina: snapshot via snapshotter-service. Someone used --window=8h manually.
paul: We need two quick mitigations: 1) enforce max default of 30m for forensics snapshots; 2) require JIT approval token for any >30m.
auditor-bot: DLP flagged email addresses and device ids in that export. Ticket LOG-612 issued.
security-bot: Logged export metadata & linked LOG-612.
oncall: I'm revoking the S3 presigned URL now and rotating the presign key. Will add a runbook step to auto-revoke if DLP score > 0.6.
omar: For KMS unwraps, require a short-lived STS token bound to a ticket_id. Add an IAM condition that denies decrypt unless requestContext.ticket_id is present.
paul: Also add an exporter-level OPA gate: deny when ttl > 1800 unless input.context.ticket_id and input.requester in data.roles["forensics_lead"]. We can ship that fast.
nina: Good. Also change the snapshotter CLI default flag from 24h -> 30m and surface a big warning when users override.
omar: Streaming exports: reduce triage streams to 1h and enforce DLP scrub pipeline before allowing raw PII.
oncall: I'll open TICKET-SEC-770 to track URL rotation, runtime guardrails, and runbook changes.
paul: Add a metric export_attempts_over_limit to alert on bypass attempts. And add audit event fields: requestor, ticket_id, token_id, reason. Those must appear in KMS CloudTrail entries or our envelope logs.
auditor-bot: Recommend retention policy: keep raw snapshots for max 7 days in a locked bucket, but scrubbed derivatives for analysis can live longer. Need compliance signoff.
nina: OK owners: oncall ticket + runbook, paul OPA PR, omar KMS policy PR, nina CLI change + warning. I'll coordinate with compliance on retention and get LOG-612 updated with actions.
oncall: Confirmed URL revoked and short TTL applied to the last export. Scheduling a 15-min follow-up at 11:00 UTC to review PR statuses.
paul: I'll add DLP pre-check webhook to snapshotter so risky exports are paused until review.
nina: Thanks all — let's keep defaults conservative and require explicit ticketing to do anything broader. :thumbsup:
